title: There Is a Deadly Lake at the Bottom of the Ocean

scenes.text: A lake at the bottom of the sea kills what swims in.
It is a brine pool, about 3,300 feet down in the Gulf of Mexico.
The water is about five times saltier than the sea around it.
It sits on the seafloor like a lake, with a shoreline.
Fish and crabs that wander in are hit by salt, methane and no oxygen.
Their bodies can stay there for years without rotting.

description:
A brine pool about 3,300 feet down in the Gulf of Mexico is roughly five times saltier than the surrounding sea.

Would you want to see it?
